data.narrative_summary: Customer Viktor Petrov (CUST-20015), owner of Petrov Trading LLC, conducted a series of rapid wire and crypto transactions across multiple linked accounts (ACC-10042, ACC-10088, ACC-10099) to obscure the origin of funds. Transactions include multiple amounts just below $10,000 threshold, including $9,999 and $9,950 wires to high-risk jurisdictions (UAE, Hong Kong, Cyprus). Funds were layered through intermediary accounts before being disbursed to offshore entities Meridian Holdings Ltd (Cyprus) and Eastern Star Consulting (UAE). Account ACC-10042 is flagged in external fraud databases (FinCEN 314(b), ACAMS, FraudNet) for prior structuring and association with a synthetic identity ring. Graph analysis confirms layering, round-tripping, and fan-out patterns consistent with trade-based money laundering. Previous SAR (SAR-2026-00147) filed January 2026 for similar activity. KYC review status: Enhanced Due Diligence completed 2026-01-20. Risk rating: High.
